errors.evidence: The description states the models are categorized into three tiers, which is information from the external paper caption, not something visually represented or labeled in the chart itself. The chart does not visually group the bars into tiers.
The chart contains 12 bars, but the description only lists the values for 9 of them. It omits the values for the second bar (48.28%), the fifth bar (48.83%), and the eighth bar (43.79%).
